hook: Your boat here docks on an island of reeds.
title: Your Boat Docks on an Island Made of Reeds
description:
On Lake Titicaca, between Peru and Bolivia, the Uros people live on floating islands woven from totora reeds. New reeds are added on top as the old ones rot away. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #LakeTiticaca #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you live on it? Yes or no
